Why it matters

Definition

Collective term for the movement of vessels and craft within port limits as monitored by VTS or Harbour Master.

Operational example

Harbour Traffic, this is tanker Baltic Star at buoy Delta, requesting clearance to shift berth to oil terminal two, over.
